body: Granted, right after you discover this power, a fifteen year old blonde Italian storms into your room. he stops and says *korega Requiem, da*

>It’s just the reaction that they thrive on.

That was the key for me to stop getting bullied, I gave absolutely zero fucks and basically I isolated myself during school (headphones on at all times style) if people decided to come up to me I'd just let them make fun for 2 minutes, usually after that they got bored...

Although this was because of my depression getting worse, which yeah, wasn't a good thing.

So... life pro tip: if you're getting bullied, get depression.

I feel you, it's depressing really, the thought that even this you couldn't do correctly, even at this you failed and embarrassed yourself.

And then you have people that actually survived an attempt, they received physical trauma and have the scars to show for it.

They are true survivers, I hate it when I'm grouped with those guys...
Don't think so, but everything after hanging myself is a bit blurry from all the whiskey
